product.description: The Monoprice™ 8K Certified Braided Ultra High Speed HDMI® Cable takes your audiovisual experience to the next level. Designed to meet the demands of cutting‑edge technology, this cable is certified by an HDMI authorized testing center, ensuring optimal performance and compatibility. With support for up to 8K@60Hz/4K@120Hz resolution and a remarkable 48Gbps bandwidth, it exceeds the requirements of the HDMI 2.1 specification.Unleash the full potential of your devices with this advanced cable. Whether you're gaming on the Sony® PlayStation® 5, PlayStation 5 Digital Edition, Microsoft® Xbox Series X™, or Xbox® Series S, this cable's next‑gen technology guarantees seamless connectivity. Immerse yourself in breathtaking visuals and smooth gameplay, as it flawlessly handles the demands of high‑resolution gaming.One of the standout features of this cable is its high‑strength braided design. Unlike ordinary cables, it is resistant to damage from cuts, kinks, and everyday wear and tear. Say goodbye to worrying about cable integrity and focus on enjoying your entertainment to the fullest.Safety is also a top priority. The CL2 in‑wall fire safety rating ensures that this cable meets stringent safety standards for in‑wall installations. You can confidently run this cable through your walls, knowing that it meets the necessary requirements and provides a secure connection.Let's explore some of the impressive features of this cable. It fully supports Dynamic HDR, delivering stunning visuals with lifelike colors and contrast. The exceptionally low electromagnetic interference (EMI) ensures a clean signal transmission, minimizing any distortions or disruptions.Gamers will appreciate the Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) support, which eliminates screen tearing and stuttering for a smooth and responsive gaming experience. Quick Media Switching (QMS) and Quick Frame Transport (QFT) further enhance gaming performance by reducing latency and improving video synchronization.Audio enthusiasts will enjoy the Enhanced Audio Return Channel (eARC) support, which enables high-quality audio transmission from compatible devices. Experience immersive soundscapes and precise audio reproduction with this cutting‑edge cable.In addition to its advanced capabilities, this HDMI cable remains backward compatible with all existing HDMI devices. So, whether you have an older gaming console, Blu‑ray player, or home theater system, you can still take advantage of its high‑speed capabilities and superior performance.Upgrade your entertainment setup with the Monoprice 8K Certified Braided Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable.
